Name: Dynamic Delay
Author: ragnarcb
Description: Control the OBS Dynamic Delay: toggle the delay, delete before it airs, instant replay, clips and panic.

Actions.Name: Toggle delay
Actions.Tooltip: Turns the delay on or off. Shows LIVE or the current delay.

Actions.Name: Delete before it airs
Actions.Tooltip: Removes the last seconds before viewers see them (needs the delay on).

Actions.Name: Instant replay
Actions.Tooltip: Replays the last seconds on air.

Actions.Name: Save clip
Actions.Tooltip: Saves the last seconds as an MP4.

Actions.Name: Panic button
Actions.Tooltip: Covers the stream and mutes the audio. Press again to end.
